text: Do you have children? I have fur babies & a couple nephews.

text: I have 3 children, dogs and cats. I like to help children in need because I can't imagine what the parents go through and I never know when something may happen close to home and I would want some type of help to get my family through a hard situation. Do you donate to Save the Children

text: I agree. Times are tough and everyone needs help every now and then. I've recently become aware of Save the Children. I've been supporting a similar organization and would like to add Save the Children to my list. What about you?

speaker: A3NYGCD9P6R6JS
text: Yes, it looks like it is very inexpensive so I would definitely add it to my list when I have extra money to donate.

text: I read that in the first two months of 2018 alone, 1000 children were reportedly killed or injured in the violence in Syria. Save the Children helps kids like that.

speaker: A3NYGCD9P6R6JS
text: That is horrible. I would definitely donate if it helps save even one life. If it helps them get through this then I am all for it. Children shouldn't have to live like that.

speaker: A3P43CP9VNH0CE
text: It's horrible. What would you say to donating all or part of your income from this task?

speaker: A3NYGCD9P6R6JS
text: I definitely will be donating part of it for sure.

text: That's great! It will make a tangible impact for sure. They are a trustable fund and make a big impact on these innocent children.

speaker: A3NYGCD9P6R6JS
text: Yes it will!

text: There's a lack of support for children in developing countries. I tend to think about animals more since I have 2 dogs and no kids of my own but after hearing about all the violence and issues these kids have, it breaks my heart

text: It's absolutely terrible. I wish people would do more to donate to help these kids but some organizations stole money from people which makes others very leery of donating. That ruined it for many and I'm sure they lost a lot of donations after that. I could not imagine my children living like this and hate seeing other children living like that. I wish I could do more.
